description: This source file contains functions for parsing markdown content, extracting translatable segments, and applying translations. It utilizes the Goldmark markdown parser and processes markdown AST nodes to identify text segments, particularly within translatable blocks such as paragraphs, headings, and list items.

methods.name: extractSegments
methods.description: Extracts translatable segments from markdown content, returning annotated segments with text and identifiers.

methods.name: applyTranslations
methods.description: Replaces original segments of markdown content with their translated counterparts.
